title: Bronze Saver Account: Interest payments and compounding
summary: This document explains Bronze Saver Account interest: interest compounds daily (balance evaluated daily), is credited monthly on a schedule, and the account earns a 2.0% APY when funds are held in the account. It also advises keeping funds through the end of the period and checking statements for daily accrual and monthly postings.
